physical.sampling: Full-duration review at 0.25 s intervals, 44 images; close LED crops and representative full-resolution frames inspected.
physical.findings: Finger manually operates protoboard switches. LED brightness varies, but exact ABC-to-output mapping and eight-state agreement are not established. No audio transcription or first-person claims used.
